name: Null Carnival — The Abandoned Infrastructure Circuit
creator: Anonymous collective; attributed to signal-name CORMORANT_ZERO
description: Null Carnival is a roving annual underground festival held in a different abandoned the Gray Zone infrastructure site each year — decommissioned water treatment plants, sealed transit tunnels, collapsed parking strata, dead freight elevators — announced only through encrypted pirate neural feed bursts 72 hours in advance. The event is part rave, part art installation, part community fair, running continuously for 60 hours with no corporate sponsorship, no entrance fee, and no registered organizers. Generators, sound systems, and food are collectively sourced, and a significant portion of each year's gathering is dedicated to the Gray Zone oral history — recorded testimonials, communal meals, and open-mic grief circles.
medium: physical / pirate neural broadcast / encrypted location feed
cultural_impact: Null Carnival has become the primary annual ritual of the Gray Zone counter-culture — a proof-of-concept that large-scale community gathering can exist entirely outside corponation infrastructure, which makes it an object of genuine institutional anxiety.
controversy: Meridian Emergency Broadcast Authority has attempted to triangulate and shut down Null Carnival at least six times; the 2218 attempt resulted in a confrontation in the Lakeview Transit Catacombs that left two MEBA officers and one attendee hospitalized, and the incident is still in contested legal proceedings.
story_hooks: Someone has leaked the 2224 Null Carnival location to a corponation security contractor 48 hours before the encrypted announcement goes out — and the leak came from inside the collective's coordination network.

A Tier 4 urban archaeologist attends Null Carnival for research and becomes stranded when their BCI's location logging is remotely wiped by a collective member who doesn't trust their presence — leaving them genuinely lost in a decommissioned water treatment labyrinth.

The oral history archive from seven years of Null Carnival — thousands of hours of the Gray Zone testimony recorded at the grief circles — has been copied and is being offered for sale to a corponation media division by someone who attended under false pretenses.
